name: Value DeFi vSafe StrategyAlpacaWBNB in-flight ibBNB valuation
summary: StrategyAlpacaWBNB values its ibBNB position at Alpaca Vault totalToken()/totalSupply(), and the vSafe WBNB vault mints shares against that value. Inside Alpaca Vault.work() the lent BNB has left the vault before the debt is booked, so totalToken() reads about half its true value. The attacker opened an Alpaca position through a strategy that calls an attacker-chosen farming token, re-entered vSafe depositFor() from that token's approve() at the depressed share price, and redeemed the excess shares at the true price in later transactions.
notes: Immutable StrategyAlpacaWBNB runtime holds the totalToken()-based valuation; the controller counted it in the vault balance from 173 seconds after deployment through the exploit, apart from a 66-second list rewrite that restored it.

Vault WBNB paid to the attacker in nine redemptions minus the attacker's own WBNB deposits in the nine re-entrant deposits: 24267.906010457069055632 - 18922.591338882848871944 WBNB. The attacker's deposits are campaign inputs, not victim loss. Alpaca's lent BNB was repaid within each work() call and is excluded. Reported totals near $11m combine other Value DeFi pools and incidents and are not used.

Alpaca's PancakeswapV2StrategyAddBaseTokenOnly (proxy 0xe38ebfe8f314dcad61d5adcb29c1a26f41bed0be, implementation 0x77d23aff927f3d46e51d449372c957b3cbbfb40e) accepts an unvalidated farmingToken and supplied the re-entry callback, but Alpaca's own repayment invariant held and it lost nothing, so it is recorded as the entry path, not a target.
